news.title: BofA cuts PG&E to Neutral as California wildfire reforms fall short
news.summary: Investing.com -- Bank of America downgraded PG&E Corp. to Neutral from Buy on Tuesday, saying California's latest wildfire legislation failed to provide the durable liability and financing framework needed to support the utility's ambitious investment plans.

news.title: PG&E, Edison Suffer Biggest Stock Drops in Years on California Wildfire Legislation
news.summary: Shares of publicly traded utilities tumbled today after an effort by California Gov. Gavin Newsom to shield the sector from wildfire-related lawsuits was rejected by state lawmakers.  California utility PG&E shares tumbled 20%, their biggest drop since the Covid-19 selloff of March 2020.  Other California-based utility stocks also sank, including Edison International.
